text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, April...!!
I avenged you, you bastard!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"If they hold the Satsuki Sho in April again next year,
just leave it to me!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Next year, I'm gonna shatter it all to pieces with these fists of mineeee!!!!

"Only those in the Classic Year can enter
the Satsuki Sho—
Before I could tell her that, she had already dashed off..."
